nameOrigin: large storage unit or heavily amored vehicle

pokedexEntries.go: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

pokedexEntries.si: If it has just had a baby, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

pokedexEntries.cr: In order to milk a MILTANK, one must have a knack for rhythmically pulling up and down on its udders.

pokedexEntries.rs: MILTANK gives over five gallons of milk on a daily basis. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can’t drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

pokedexEntries.oras: Miltank gives over five gallons of milk on a daily basis. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can’t drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

pokedexEntries.su: Its milk is high in calories and packed with nutrients. Therefore, if you drink too much of it, you may wind up with a body like Miltank’s.

pokedexEntries.mo: Most people raise it for its milk, but it’s quite tough and strong, so it’s also well suited for battle.

pokedexEntries.us: It produces over five gallons of milk a day. The higher the quality of the pastures it lives in, the richer and tastier its milk becomes.

pokedexEntries.um: Its milk is delicious and chock-full of nutrients. However, if you drink too much, it could make your stomach hurt, so be careful.

pokedexEntries.sw: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it’s been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.
